phase1.title: WELCOME, HUNTER
phase1.body:
The System has awakened. There is only one path ahead: get stronger.

This guide will show you how the System world works.

phase1.title: DAILY MISSIONS
phase1.body:
Here you find your tasks for today. Complete them to earn XP, level up, and accumulate Gold.

If you complete all dailies, you receive a special reward.

phase1.title: MISSION FORGE
phase1.body:
You can adapt missions to your real life! At the top you find the FORGE to edit your routines.

· CORE MISSIONS (Fixed): Occur daily without exception.
· POOL MISSIONS (Extra): The System draws randomly from your deck each day.

phase1.title: YOUR PROFILE & SETTINGS
phase1.body:
Here you see your attributes, your Hunter Rank (which rises automatically), and your titles.

In the top-right corner, the Gear icon lets you adjust DIFFICULTY, affecting XP gained and lost.

phase1.title: YOUR SHADOW ARMY
phase1.body:
Shadows are warriors you extract by defeating bosses or completing all daily missions.

Each has a unique passive effect that strengthens you automatically.

phase1.title: THE SYSTEM SHOP
phase1.body:
Use Gold to buy XP Potions, rerolls, and other consumables.

Once you reach Level 10, unique shadows become available for recruitment.

phase1.title: FOCUS MODE & PENALTIES
phase1.body:
Activate Focus Mode to block distractions.

Failing daily missions puts you in the PENALTY ZONE and you lose XP. In Focus Hardcore mode, failing the timer temporarily blocks your phone!

phase1.title: READY TO BEGIN
phase1.body:
Your first mission is simple: complete today's Daily Missions.

The more consistent you are, the higher your Rank will rise. Go forward, Hunter.

phase2.title: LEVEL 10 — SHADOWS AWAKEN
phase2.body:
You've reached an important milestone. From now on, Shadows begin to reveal themselves more frequently.

Let me show you how to manage your army.

phase2.title: YOUR SHADOW
phase2.body:
Each shadow has a UNIQUE PASSIVE EFFECT — automatic bonuses that apply to your missions.

Higher ranks (Commander, Marshal) have much more powerful effects.

phase2.title: ADD TO FAVORITES
phase2.body:
Tap the ⭐ icon to favorite.

Your 3 favorite shadows apply their global passive effects: from protecting you from losing XP in the Penalty Zone, to granting attribute bonuses.

phase2.title: ACTIVE PASSIVE EFFECTS
phase2.body:
With favorite shadows activated, their bonuses apply automatically: more XP per mission, more Gold per quest, penalty regeneration, etc.

You can see active bonuses in your Profile.

phase2.title: THE MONARCH AWAKENS
phase2.body:
Keep conquering, Hunter. The most powerful shadows are yet to come — Rank S bosses await you.

Forge your army. Become unstoppable.

app.penalty_banner: PENALTY ZONE ACTIVE — Complete the penalty missions!

shadow_miss.title: THE SHADOW ESCAPED!
shadow_miss.lore: "The darkness recedes... but the shadow awaits its next opportunity."
